description: This file defines the BookingAccessService class, which manages access control for bookings, including checking user roles, permissions, and relationships to determine access rights.

classes.name: BookingAccessService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to determine user access to bookings based on roles, permissions, and relationships.

methods.name: isUserAHost
methods.description: Checks if a user is a host or attendee of a booking.

methods.name: doesUserIdHaveAccessToBooking
methods.description: Main method to determine if a user has access to a specific booking, considering various roles and permissions.
